dashboard.welcome.title: Welcome to AI Workbench
dashboard.welcome.desc: Bind the large language model (LLM) seamlessly to the Aviation Core ontology (Aviation Core). Here you can configure decision logic flows (AIP Logic), deploy conversation interaction agents (AIP Agents), and enforce enterprise-grade private boundaries and data security guardrails (Guardrails) with full real-time auditing.
